summary: The distilled end-bent backwall, cheek-wall and tie-back strap report (EndBentBackwallDesign; 19 October 2026 notebook case, decision D-057) is appended to the journal as a registered module with live references to BridgeGeometry_2Beam (end-bent cap, backwall thickness, cheek thickness, pedestal, bearing pad, Span 1, backwall drop), Materials (strengths) and ProjectInfo (stamp), linked from the PedBridge index under Specific calculations and foundations. PedBridge, BridgeGeometry_2Beam and FoundationModeling no longer record the backwall report as outside the journal; DecisionLog gains the entry. All other components are byte identical.
published_outputs: EndBentBackwallDesign: Status (current distilled result: All Checks Pass), the 27 DC_* demand/capacity ratios with their Chk_* result strings, DC_max and DC_ymax; the plan loads f_str_s = 3.089 kip/ft (service) and f_str_u = 3.737 kip/ft (factored, Strength I governing); drop_bw = BridgeGeometry_2Beam.EndBent_backwallDrop

Distilled numerical checks only, not design acceptance. Section 12 lists the pending prerequisites of the notebook: geotechnical settlement confirmation (SDG 3.13.2.N.3), strap elevation at an MSE reinforcement level, environmental classification for the covers, post-seating shrinkage strain, user confirmation of the bearing actions and common end-bent envelope, cheek mat development and cap/lug load path
assumptions_and_conventions: The report is the Blockpad journal edition of the 19 October 2026 notebook case (project_current/cap_design/backwall/Backwall Design 10-19.html and selected_case.json, D-057), built by scripts/build_backwall_bpad.py --journal; the notebook package was reconciled with the register (End Bent 1_Fixed.XML of D-049, the D-051 case, the D-053/D-055 CAD model measured natively, the T016 journal) and rerun before the export

Live references: b_cap, h_cap, L_cap, L_bw, L_load, embed_pile, tol_pile, t_bw, e_brg, h_ped, B_ped, t_pad, t_ck, G_pad, L_pad, W_pad, n_int, t_int, t_cov, L_exp read BridgeGeometry_2Beam; fc, fy, Es read Materials; the ProjectStamp cells read ProjectInfo. A coherence gate compared each journal value with the case input to 1 part in 10^9 before the build (23 references). s_brg stays the literal 102.99 in from the export's bearing stations; the journal beam spacing is 8 ft 7 in (103 in); recorded in end_bent_walls/bpad/journal/coherence.json

drop_bw references EndBent_backwallDrop (4.25 in) beside the backwall heights H_bw and H_bw_edge, which are literals measured from the D-055 model built with that drop; the gate compared the journal drop with the model's TopDrop

Blockpad has no vector variables: the five load combinations, the three members and the eight torsion stations are scalars; each equation is shown once and the others sit in collapsed sections with green tables (see end_bent_walls/bpad and cap_bpad/README.md)

Pass/fail strings, styles and table colour rules follow standards/BPAD_Ref_V5.txt; the document-level PASS and FAIL rules and the Result only style already exist in the journal. Units kip, ft, in, ksi as the notebook
The added report is a bare fragment (LF line endings, 2-space indent) appended unchanged, as in T012 and T015; the edited modules keep their CRLF line endings
downstream_impact: No existing component reads the new report's names; check reports the usual all-component impact hints only

The report reads BridgeGeometry_2Beam, Materials and ProjectInfo; a change to a referenced value changes the report's results on recalculation (and the standalone sheet end_bent_walls/End Bent Backwall Design.bpad, which holds literals, would then need a rebuild from a new case)
The FBMP, cap and pile records are not changed
external_analysis: FB-MultiPier was not re-run. The bearing actions of the report are the D-049 fixed-run End Bent 1 export (End Bent 1_Fixed.XML c1a4afa1...), read by the notebook, not live in Blockpad; the End Bent 2 export reads the same bearing actions. Their currency against the final design (COH-013, COH-028) and the common end-bent envelope are not asserted; they are the pending analysis prerequisite listed in Section 12. LRFD and SDG checks were recomputed by the notebook's own evaluator and by the generator's independent Blockpad-syntax evaluator.
